critical_biases: Selection can enrich linked passenger variants and does not alone identify the causal allele.
Post-editing state measurements cannot be relabelled as pre-intervention phase.
Sequence context, dose, duration, cell line and batch can alter both editing distribution and phenotype.
Population-level allele frequencies may not provide per-cell allele-to-phenotype linkage.
counterfactual_question: For a matched cell population with the same initial state, editor, guide, target, dose and environment, would the allele or phenotype response differ if a valid pre-intervention phase were different?
